==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Blood Bear escaped captivity using the Universe key, and started attacking two Marshmallow Men. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Blood Bear resembled a muscular humanoid purple bear with a large heart shaped scar on his chest.) (The pocket universe key resembled a glowing key covered in rainbow stripes.) (Marshmallow Men resemble men with large white cylindrical marshmallow heads, with large oval shaped black eyes, and humanoid bodies made of stitched together sticks. They have retractable stretchy tongues made of marshmallow.)
Using my Lucid Light, I took control of one of the Marshmallow Men and used its stretchy tongue to snatch away the key. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
The key lands in my grasp and I quickly use it to open a portal beneath Blood Bear, trapping him in his pocket universe. (Pocket Universe Key Portals resemble glowing swirling rainbow colored portals.)
